title: iCore
description: iCore is a modern, feature-rich server management plugin that combines combat logging prevention with comprehensive player management systems. All features are accessible through an intuitive multi-page GUI.
body:
# ℹ️ iCore

> **Project Status:** `BETA / INDEV`
>  
> *Security Notice: This plugin has been thoroughly tested, optimized, and verified safe for use in live production environments. However, due to the nature of dynamic block scanning and comprehensive systems management, absolute safety under extreme edge cases cannot be unconditionally guaranteed. And this project is still In Development.*

iCore is a high-performance, feature-packed Spigot plugin designed to be the central nervous system of your Minecraft server. It merges Combat Logging, Persistent Map Restoration, Advanced Kits, and Pro Admin Tools into one seamless, GUI-driven experience. Stop cluttering your server with dozens of loose plugins. iCore handles it all with a focus on speed, clean aesthetics, and deep customization.

---

### 📋 Key Technical Specifications

> *   **Platform Support:** `Paper` | `Spigot` | `Purpur`
> *   **Target Environment:** Minecraft `1.21.11` *(Compiled, tested, and optimized for 1.21.11)*
> *   **Runtime Requirement:** `Java 21` or higher

---

### ⚡ System Features

#### • The Master Switch (`/icore`)
> **Core Administration:**
> Manage your entire server without ever touching a config file through a centralized dashboard:
> *   System Toggles: Enable or disable entire categories (Combat, Kits, Maps) with a single click.
> *   Granular Control: Right-click any category to toggle individual commands.
> *   Real-time Enforcement: Disabled commands show a custom "Disabled in /icore" message immediately.
> *   Safety First: Operators have access to everything by default, and every action can be undone.

#### • Professional Combat Log
> **PVP Enforcement:**
> Automated handling and detection arrays for in-game combat interactions:
> *   Dynamic Tagging: Automated tagging loops for attackers and victims.
> *   Action Bar Display: Bold, colorful on-screen countdown: `⚔ Combat Tag: 15s ⚔`.
> *   Restricted Areas: Define coordinate-based zones that players cannot enter while in combat.
> *   Anti-Log Protection: Automatically kills and drops the inventory of players who disconnect while tagged.

#### • Revolutionary Kit System
> **Asset Distribution:**
> Advanced kit deployment interface featuring personalized user layout configurations:
> *   Infinite GUI: Multi-page kit menus with professional Black Stained Glass backgrounds.
> *   Personalized Alignment: A first-of-its-kind feature! Players can Right-Click a kit to open an editor and decide exactly which hotbar or armor slot each item should land in.
> *   Smart Sync: Automatically equips armor and offhand items if the player's slots are empty.
> *   Visual Layout Editor: Use `/kitgui` to drag-and-drop kits into specific slots across infinite pages.

#### • Persistent Map Reset
> **World Restoration:**
> High-speed region backup and automated rolling rollbacks with zero TPS impact:
> *   Cursor Sync: Define regions effortlessly—the plugin suggests the X, Y, Z of the block you are currently looking at when you press Tab!
> *   Looping Restoration: Set maps to auto-restore on a timer (e.g., reset the arena every 10 minutes).
> *   Restart Proof: All map data and active loops resume automatically after a server restart.

---

### 🕹️ Operational Workflow

#### 📦 Step 1: Management & Utility
> **System Control:**
> `/icore [info|help]` — Open the Master GUI or view plugin info.
> `/heal [player]` — Restore health to max.
> `/feed [player]` — Fill the hunger bar.
> `/speed <1-10>` — Set walk or fly speed.
> `/gm <0/1/2/3>` — Change gamemode (Survival, Creative, Adventure, Spectator).
> `/god [player]` — Toggle invincibility.
> `/utilundo` — Revert your last gamemode or speed change.

#### 🔋 Step 2: Kit System
> **Inventory Allocation:**
> `/kit [name]` — Open the kit GUI or claim a specific kit. *(Aliases: `/k`, `/kits`)*
> `/kitcreate <name> <cooldown> [icon]` — Create a kit from your current inventory and set an icon.
> `/kitedit <name> [cooldown] [icon]` — Edit items or metadata of an existing kit. *(Aliases: `/kg`, `/kitedit`)*
> `/kitgui` — Open the admin layout editor to arrange kits in the menu.
> `/setkit <name|none>` — Set the default starter kit.

#### 🪓 Step 3: Combat Log
> **PVP Management:**
> `/combatlogarea <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2>` — Set the combat-restricted zone. *(Alias: `/cra`)*
> `/combatlogtag <player|@s>` — Manually tag/untag a player. *(Alias: `/ctag`)*
> `/combatlogbypass <player>` — Toggle a player's ability to log out safely. *(Alias: `/cbypass`)*
> `/combatlogexempt <player>` — Toggle if a player can be tagged at all. *(Alias: `/cexempt`)*
> `/combatstatus [player]` — View current combat timer. *(Alias: `/cstatus`)*
> `/combatinfo` — List all players currently in combat. *(Alias: `/cinfo`)*

#### 🔌 Step 4: Map Restoration
> **World Revision:**
> `/resetmapsave <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2> <name>` — Save a region to the database. *(Alias: `/rsave`)*
> `/restmap <name>` — Instantly restore a saved map. *(Alias: `/rm`)*
> `/rcd <time> <name>` — Schedule a one-time restoration (e.g., 5m).
> `/rl <interval|stop> <name>` — Start/Stop a repeating restoration loop. *(Alias: `/rloop`)*
> `/mapundo` — Revert the last map save or restoration task.

#### 🏠 Step 5: Homes & Teleportation
> **Spatial Routing:**
> `/sethome [name]` — Save your current location. *(Alias: `/sh`)*
> `/home [name]` — Teleport to a saved home. *(Alias: `/h`)*
> `/delhome <name>` — Delete a home. *(Alias: `/dh`)*
> `/homeundo` — Restore a deleted home or return to your previous spot.
> `/tpa <player>` — Request to teleport to someone.
> `/tpaccept` / `/tpdeny` — Manage incoming requests.
> `/back` — Return to your last death or teleport location.
> `/tpundo` — Revert the last teleportation action.

#### 🚫 Step 6: Admin Management
> **Server Enforcement:**
> `/freeze <player>` — Freeze a player in place.
> `/kick <player> [reason]` — Kick a player from the server.
> `/mute <player> [duration]` — Prevent a player from chatting.
> `/unmute <player>` — Allow a player to chat again.
> `/vanish` — Become invisible to other players.
> `/invsee <player>` — View and edit a player's inventory.
> `/sudo <player> <command>` — Force a player to run a command.
> `/timeout <player> <duration>` — Put a player in "Time Out" (Creative & invincible, but isolated).
> `/pmundo` — Revert the last freeze, mute, or timeout.

---

### 💎 Why choose iCore?

> **Architecture Design:**
> *   OP Wildcard: All operators have the `icore.*` permission by default.
> *   Smart Tab-Completion: All coordinate-based commands suggest the coordinates of your crosshair.
> *   Optimized: Built for 1.21+ with minimal impact on TPS and optimized block-handling.
> *   Premium Design: Every message and GUI is formatted for a professional "high-end" server feel.
>
> *Elevate your server management today with iCore!*
